primary_controller.role: controls the five-class DR severity grade

safety_behavior.verifier_unavailable: primary result is retained and review is recommended
safety_behavior.primary_unavailable: verifier-only fallback is marked for review
safety_behavior.both_unavailable: no referable result is fabricated; evidence is insufficient
safety_behavior.disagreement: fused referable output follows the max rule and review is recommended
safety_behavior.ood: verifier OOD is retained as a review signal; it does not rewrite severity

tests_added: maximum-probability low/low, primary-high, verifier-high, and both-high cases
severity grade remains primary when fused referability differs
disabled fusion preserves existing primary behavior
verifier unavailable, verifier-only, and insufficient-evidence fallbacks
RetinaGuard receives referable disagreement as a review signal
limitations: Fusion is not promoted to production.
RETGUARD has known IDRiD training-overlap risk in development evidence.
The fusion result is an engineering research signal, not a clinical guarantee.
